data.one_liner: A customizable Flutter chat UI package with list and conversation views.
data.what_it_does: Provides a comprehensive chat user interface for Flutter applications, supporting 1-on-1 and group chats, message reactions, replies, voice messages, link previews, and image sharing. It also includes chat list management with pagination and search.
use_when: You need to quickly implement a feature-rich chat interface in your Flutter application.
You want customizable chat bubbles, timestamps, typing indicators, and message status views.
avoid_when: You are building a custom UI from scratch and do not want pre-styled chat widgets.
strengths: Highly customizable UI components for chat lists and messages.
Supports multimedia features like voice messages, image sharing, and link previews.
Includes built-in support for message reactions, replies, and editing.
weaknesses: Requires managing state and backend syncing separately unless using chatview_connect.
Platform-specific requirements like iOS deployment targets may apply due to underlying dependencies.
